description: Unit tests and fuzzing for the FlatMap container implementation, including performance benchmarks and map equality checks.

classes.name: MapTester
classes.description: A helper class for testing FlatMap against std::map, including insertion, erasure, and equality checks.

methods.name: CheckMapEquality
methods.description: Checks if two maps are equal in size and content.

methods.name: MapToString
methods.description: Converts a map to a string representation for debugging.

methods.name: MapTester::Insert
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair into both std::map and FlatMap and checks for consistency.

methods.name: MapTester::BulkInsert
methods.description: Inserts multiple key-value pairs and verifies map consistency.

methods.name: MapTester::Erase
methods.description: Erases a key from both maps and checks for consistency.

methods.name: MapTester::BulkErase
methods.description: Erases multiple keys and verifies map consistency.

methods.name: MapTester::Clear
methods.description: Clears both maps and checks for consistency.

methods.name: MapTester::RandomKey
methods.description: Generates a random key for testing.

methods.name: MapTester::RandomValue
methods.description: Generates a random value for testing.

methods.name: GetThreadTimeMonotonicNow
methods.description: Returns current thread time or monotonic time as fallback.
